articles.title: 3 US Life Insurance Stocks That Could Gain From Higher For Longer Rates
articles.summary: Fed officials are hinting that interest rates could stay higher for longer, and that keeps rippling through everything from mortgage costs to insurer investment returns. While some sectors strain under 7.5% home loan rates and sticky 3.7% CPI inflation, others quietly see better income from the cash they reinvest. This article unpacks that story and discusses 3 life insurance and annuity stocks that appear most exposed to this latest Fed signal. The three stocks below are just a sample set,...
